metric: cparse: function identification and strict comparison with /lib/cparse (host/recon/strictcmp.py)
metric_def: strict: only code addresses (jump/call targets, function addresses) masked; data, bss, constants and frame offsets compared
schema: functions: name -> file (our source), orig (entry), size_orig, status (open, done, findings, crt0); manual_classes: name -> basis, d_classes, note (the only place of the notes of a finding)

audit.difference_note: unexplained instruction forms: lda	rS,A(rS); set	A,#0; set	A,#1; set	A,#2; set	A,#3
unexplained instruction forms: multl	rqS,A(rS); multl	rqS,rrS
unexplained instruction forms: multl	rqS,rrS; srl	rS,#2

defid.note: Remaining: the original places the member/structure-name block (the WEGA name space check, label mismatch) between the then and the else part of the dimension test inside the loop over the dimensions; our source has it at the PCC place behind the switch (same control flow). Tried: the PCC layout. Open: a source layout that gives the original block order (goto into the loop body like in optim?).

genswitch.note: Remaining: the size of the search table (n*SZLONG/SZCHAR as an unsigned long): the original divides with div and zero-extends, our cc shifts (srl #3) for (unsigned)(...); a new compiler difference candidate (the old cc does not turn an unsigned division by a power of 2 into a shift). Tried: (unsigned)(n*SZLONG/SZCHAR).

lxstr.note: Remaining: the lastcon |= val<<8 arm uses rr0 in the original, rr4 in ours (D2), and it is placed in front of the case bodies in the original (layout); the outer switch is a compare chain (D6).

argregs.note: Source fix: n = argregs( p->left ) in front of return( n + argregs( p->right ) ) (the original keeps the first count in r13, no frame temporary). Remaining: popt merges the two add r2,r13 tails (D11) and the block order behind the compare chain.

rmconv.note: Source: bsize(q->type) == bsize(q->left->type) and notflt in the same order, for the call order of the original (D19).

clocal.note: Source: tbytes(l->type) > tbytes(p->type) for the call order of the original (D19); the rest are register and layout differences.

argdebug.note: Source fix: only register a (the original saves one register variable). Remaining: popt renames a into r1 and drops its save.

yyparse.note: cgram1.y is the V7/System III/Plexus grammar with one more nonterminal lcon_e (a long constant expression, lcons) for the three array dimensions: with it every yacc table (yyexca, yyact, yypact, yypgo, yyr1, yyr2, yychk, yydef) equals the original. tools/actcmp.py compares the actions rule by rule: 135 of 178 equal with frame and registers hidden; the rest are shared tails (D11), register and reload differences.

hash.note: Source fix: the locals are declared h, p (the original has h at the lower frame place, the old cc gives the first declared local the lower place).

hide.note: Source fix: no unused local h (the original frame has i only; an unused local gets a frame place in the old cc too, initpreg).

lookup.note: Source fix: one more unused int between i and n (the original has a frame word there; its name j is a guess).

nidcl.note: Source fix: the empty array warning for AUTO and REGISTER (the original compares with 4); the source had EXTDEF.

getpreg.note: Source fix: the parameters declared t, p (the original has t in r14 and p in r13; the first declared register variable gets r14). Remaining: popt places the gotreg block behind the inverted test (jr lt), the original keeps it in place (jr ge): the old popt turns a conditional jump over a jump round before it follows the jump to a jump; tried as OLD_D20S, neutral (yyparse, gotscal worse).

fhashv.note: Source fix: register n (the original saves r14 and gives n no home: a register parameter behind the last other one, OLD_D4R). Remaining: the original takes n from r6 and does not restore r14 (popt renames the register variable), the byte loads use rl3 throughout.

cisreg.note: Source fix: t is not a register parameter (the original uses r7 and saves no r14).

tyreduce.note: Source fix: the dimension goes through a long local (the original stores (unsigned)temp into a 4 byte frame place and passes it from the register of the assignment); the name off is a guess, Plexus passes (OFFSZ)temp directly.

vfdzero.note: Source fix: register n (the original saves r14 and gives n no home).

tcopy.note: Source fix: ncopy( q=talloc(), p ) and a register r = p->rval as in Plexus (the original saves r12, r13, r14; r unused afterwards).

ncopy.note: Source fix: register NODE *q, *p and an unused register i (the original saves r12; popt renames q and p into r4 and r5).

beginit.note: Source fix: defalign( talign(...) ) without the local al (the original stores no al).

endinit.note: Source fix: inforce( tsize(...) ) without the local tsz (the original stores no tsz).

falloc.note: Source fix: s is a local of the ENUMTY case block (the original reuses its frame place for a codgen temporary).

tymatch.note: Source fix: register NODE *p1 as in Plexus (an eighth register variable: the original gives it an unused frame word).

buildtree.note: Source fix: one more unused int at the function level, and in the STREF block the locals in the order cp2, cp1, an unused int, j, k (the frame places of the original); the names of the unused ones are guesses.
